Credit to supply orders
Summer has been kind to the desk
Steady paws, steady plans

The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways is moving fast, and the line is clear: keep supplies checked, keep carriers ready, and keep every handoff calm. <<FACT F031>> Staff are staying sharp on intake, and every animal is getting patient attention from trained people while supervisors listen closely when travelers raise concerns. That steady approach matters when a cabin is full and the schedule tightens.

We are also tightening coordination with the flight teams so no one misses a detail at boarding or after landing. <<FACT F053>> Please keep notes crisp, confirm tags before release, and flag any change at once. Travelers like Dylan Moretti, Naomi Davis, and Scout have reminded us that calm updates make a hard day easier, so keep the tone friendly and the process firm. Aurelia Skyways counts on the Companion Animal Travel Desk to stay ready, stay visible, and keep the next handoff smooth.
